crossRefs.note: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt. You use many medicines in vain. There is no healing for you.
Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed! Wail for her! Take balm for her pain. Perhaps she may be healed.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

translations.web: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then isn’t the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
translations.bsb: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is no physician there? Why then has the health of the daughter of my people not been restored?
translations.kjv: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
